ms.promise:
The project contains three types of outputs to drive the growth of the Turkish Cardano community and to spread Cardano in Turkiye: events, educational content, and social media engagement. For this milestone the outputs will be:
・Weekly events and totaling 8 events held for this milestone
・16 podcasts covering Cardano topics
・100+ social media posts
ms.criteria:
Events
・Events will be mostly held online in Discord/Zoom/or some other environment. They may be held in the real world in university and fairs if possible.
・Events will focus on learn together sessions to learn Cardano fundamentals, wallets, DeFi, games, with the aim of getting people involved with Cardano.

Podcasts
・As we learn we will produce short, quality content to teach users the Turkish community about Cardano concepts. The content will be similar to those covered in the events yet more accessible. 
・Content will be a mix of 10-20 minute podcasts. They will be published on https://pod
